entries.description: A pull request that changes harness.yaml with no reviews fails and names the file, the matched rule, and its owner.
An APPROVED review on the head SHA from a code owner who is not the author passes. The author's own review does not.
An APPROVED review on an older commit does not count.
The solo-maintainer label passes. A synchronize event runs the label-removal job and the check fails until the label is added again. A backdated committer date has no effect.
A label added by a user who is not in CODEOWNERS does not count.
Added lines that match review.humanRequired.patterns need approval even when the file is not on a protected path.
A pull request with no protected changes passes without calling the reviews or timeline APIs.
A push to the default branch with protected changes and no pull request fails. A push to a feature branch is skipped.
A missing GITHUB_TOKEN or a GitHub API error exits 2.
.github/CODEOWNERS exists and covers every protected glob, plus itself.
codeowners-coverage fails when a protected glob has no owner, and passes on this tree.
--install leaves an existing CODEOWNERS byte-identical and reports uncovered globs.
A check-integrity pass that relies on a local record prints the early-warning line.
harness/ and docs/ do not call the local record the decision. The test lists the forbidden phrases.
ADR 0007 exists, is in the index, and passes adr-frontmatter.
The README trust-model section names protected-change, the label route, label clearing on push, and the branch-protection caveat.
Without a ship instruction, pre_tool refuses gh label, review, and merge commands, and still allows gh pr view and gh pr checks.
docs/guide.md has the fourteen steps in order and the README links it within the first 40 lines.
doc-drift fails an unknown guide flag, a CLI flag missing from the guide, and a missing README link. It passes on this tree.
Every guide code block that starts with ./verify.sh runs in a fixture without exiting 2. --loop, --install, and --allow-check-edit only check --help.
